correctness.rationale: The proof verifies the exact neighbor-degree identity, identifies the two exhaustive fort regimes and proves full inclusion-minimality for each; the spanning case reduces to minimal edge covers and the nonspanning case to a single cycle. Labeled exponential-formula weights are checked for the size-two boundary and arbitrary k. Independent direct graph enumeration over 2,131,011 nonempty subsets for n=3..7 matches every cardinality coefficient and every structural type.

value.rationale: The minimal-fort hypergraph is the complete irredundant constraint family for fort-cover formulations of zero forcing. This theorem identifies it for a classical infinite strongly regular graph family as precisely spanning star forests plus nonspanning cycles, with a closed labeled enumerator and a complete sharp cardinality spectrum including the unique uniform case. This is motivated structural and enumerative information unavailable from a minimum-fort calculation alone.
